notes:
Lead profile: inbound sign-up (free tier) -> prodded by support chat re: latency. Small engineering org (fullstack + mobile). Using Redwood hosted API; self-serve so far.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-25: Signup via quickstart; ran hello-chat test from eu-west, reported 800-1200ms tail latency on 2s sample windows.
- 2026-03-02: Intro call (15m) with Avery + Diego. Customer: 'US is fine, EU feels laggy during peak'. We captured Fireflies ff_20260302_001.
- 2026-03-04: Customer ran simple perf script, attached results to Drive (PoC_Checklist). Observed median 320ms in us-west, p95 ~980ms in eu-west.
- 2026-03-09: Follow-up chat re: client timeouts; customer getting 'deadline exceeded' errors in frontend during long LLM responses.

Use-case/requirements summary:
- Workload: customer chat widget + FAQ fallback. High read ratio, moderate concurrency (~50 concurrent users peak). Low $$ sensitivity for now but care about UX.
- Targets: interactive latency target 200-400ms median, p95 <800ms for core messages.
- Model: using a mid-sized open model from Redwood catalog; prefer hosted variants. No heavy embedding workloads yet.
- Routing: prefer region-aware routing (closest region for EU users). Expect automatic fallback if region capacity constrained.
- Security: SSO planned (Auth0) and basic audit events; SOC2 not required at initial stage.

Perf notes & troubleshooting performed:
- Quick wins suggested to customer on call: pick nearest region (eu-west for EU, us-west for NA), enable streaming to reduce perceived latency, and reduce prompt context size for short replies.
- Observed from PoC logs: EU traffic routed through us-central occasionally due to default routing; we suspect DNS-based edge selection mismatch.
- Advised client to set client-side HTTP timeout to 10s (instead of 3s) and implement exponential backoff with jitter (initial 200ms, max 2s). Also recommended server-side request timeout 30s for long-form generation endpoints.
- Prompt guidance: trim system/context tokens; move long static documents to embeddings + retrieval, keep generative prompts under ~1024 tokens where possible.
- Suggested retry policy: idempotent GET-like calls (embedding) retry 2x; stateful chat should present last-saved partial response rather than blind retry.

Internal notes / AE shorthand:
- Good quick win opp for hosted_api t-shirt sale. Low friction -> try to close by Apr if PoC shows p95 <800ms EU.
- Potential upsell: region pinning / reserved capacity if they outgrow free plan.

Quotes / client voice:
- 'If EU users wait more than a second they bounce' — product lead.
- 'We can accept slightly slower p95 if median is snappy' — eng lead.

Next steps (detailed):
1) Team to stand up 48hr PoC from us-west and eu-west; provide PoC config snippet + suggested client timeout/backoff. (Action: SE Diego)
2) Share short 'Hosted API perf tuning' cheat-sheet (3 bullets for region, streaming, prompt size). (Action: AE Avery)
3) Re-run perf test w/ region pinning + streaming enabled; capture p50/p95 and attach to Drive. (Customer)
4) Follow-up demo w/ metrics review in week of 2026-03-17.

Attachments & refs: Drive PoC checklist + perf results, Fireflies id ff_20260302_001, INF-3421 (internal ticket about routing edge selection).
